entities.summary: The Ziarat Shareef is a mosque and madrasah, located in Kakrala city, in the Budaun district of the state of Uttar Pradesh, India. The building was designed and built by Shah Saqlain Miyan. The building also contains the Khatoli Shareef of Shah Dargahi Miyan. People from across the country come to visit the Khatoli Shareef. This visit is called the ziyarat, hence the name of this building.
